Lower Text: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple Digimon card with [Ravemon] in its name or [Bird] or [Avian] in one of its traits and 1 [Keenan Crier] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
